label: The End of This Story: A

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Heh, looks like you've finally calmed down a bit.
Gluttony seems to be consumed by pain, its body shaking violently and stiffening.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Even a big ol' Rapture like you has its limits when it comes to pain, huh?
Yuni's arms, which have been holding Gluttony's mouth open, begin to creak.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's exerting a lot of force, isn't it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Shall I help you lift this?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I know it must be tough, but you're holding up well.
Yuni looks at her creaking arms.
Because the moment she does, two lives will be in danger.
Yuni suddenly feels as if the weight pressing down on her is that of two lives.
the way she frivolously threw words around when taking countless lives.
If she were to bear the weight of all the lives lost to her thoughtless words back then,
just how heavy would it be?
In that instant, Yuni feels the unbearable weight of her sins.
She now realizes the full weight of that promise she made then.
The promise that she would do anything.
The greater her realization, the greater the weight of her sins upon her shoulders.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'm here to bear the burden with you.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's why I gained this strength.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Let's rescue those who see our presence as a gift,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: the ones who consider us friends.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If we keep saving them all, one by one,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: we'll be able to find the path to redemption.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll be right there with you, Yuni, until we reach the end of that path.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I wonder if Mori managed to convince Siren.
From inside Gluttony's mouth, two small bubbles pop out.
The two tiny bubbles float toward Yuni and Mihara's ears,
Mihara quickly pulls out the pendulum and retreats along with Yuni.
Just as they've made their escape...
A massive water bubble shoots out of Gluttony's mouth.
The bubble plunges into the ocean,
silver liquid pours down from the sky.
A massive purple bubble spreads out above Yuni and Mihara like an umbrella, shielding them from the silver rain.
At the center stands Little Mermaid and Mori.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I won't let anything hurt you, ever.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Do I really have to fire this thing?
Mori nervously looks at the bubble gun in her hand.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Let me make sure I've got this right:

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: the bubble bullet containing the crystals is loaded in here,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: and once I pull the trigger, it'll fly straight towards the core, right?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: And while you do that, I'll send this entire space up to the surface.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That way, we can protect ourselves from any unforeseen dangers the crystals might pose.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You're going to bring up this entire area?!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's why I need your help.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The moment I make this space float, that's when you fire that gun.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That way, the bullet will hit the core at the same time we surface.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: But what if I mess up? What if I miss the core?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: The bullet will find its mark.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... In other words, even if I miss, you'll use your Kotodama to make sure it lands where it should.
Mori positions herself under the bubble tree, where she has the clearest view of Gluttony's core.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: ... I'm ready. Let me know when I need to shoot.
and gives a command to every bubble in the surrounding area.
With a powerful tremor, the space encased in bubbles begins to float.
Mori locks her eyes onto Gluttony's floating red core.
The bullet ejects from the bubble gun, pierces through the bubble wall,
and heads straight for Gluttony's core.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I thought I was gonna die back there...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We made sure it hit Gluttony's core.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We saw it start to expand.
The formerly paralyzed Gluttony starts to slowly lurch about.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I guess that wasn't quite enough to do the trick.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: it doesn't look like it had no effect.
Little Mermaid points to Gluttony's mouth.
countless crystals continually form and dissolve into the silver liquid.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, looks like it chowed down on those crystals, all right.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We must eliminate Gluttony once and for all before the silver liquid completely dissolves the crystals.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: will you fight by my side?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Ha, as if you had to ask.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Yeah, don't be silly and ask such an obvious question!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I already told you; we're all coming back alive.
Little Mermaid is surrounded by friends who risked their lives to save her.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: We're all making it out of here alive. Let's win this together.
